subject: [AMBER] Developing Parameters for Bad Atom Types

messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
MM-GBSA is returning a “bad atom type” error because my system includes Au atoms— I’m looking at a protein-Au surface system, and previously, the below publication used the MM-GBSA approach to assess initial protein-surface docking poses (
https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/acs.jpclett.5b02746
<
https://pubs.acs.org/doi/abs/10.1021/acs.jpclett.5b02746
>).
I know how to add the parameters to the mdread2.f90 file and how to recompile the code afterwards. I just don’t know where I can find the appropriate parameters, or how I can compute them, for Au. I’d greatly appreciate any suggestions.
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
I don't have good suggestions for parameter development for Au, but I would
have concerns over using GB for something like Au. MM-PBSA might be a
better option and has fewer empirical parameters to worry about.
